visual_theme.theme_mode: Dark Arcade Base with High Contrast Neon Accent Cards

typography.font_header: Barlow Condensed, Outfit, sans-serif (Heavyweight athletic/arcade feel, font-black, tracking-tight)
typography.font_digits: JetBrains Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace for grid numbers and card values

responsive_breakpoints.mobile: max-w-md mx-auto px-3 py-4 (portrait thumb-reachable design)
responsive_breakpoints.desktop: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-8 (split view with side HUD and fanned hand)

sonoko_hybrid.cell_tinting: Cells are tinted in Red, Blue, Green, or Yellow background shades
sonoko_hybrid.hand_mechanics: Fanned bottom card hand (1-6 numbered cards in 4 colors + Wild + Reveal Action)
sonoko_hybrid.card_play_rules: Card must match Discard Pile top card (by color OR number) AND be legally placeable in the 6x6 Sudoku grid (no digit duplicate in row, col, 2x3 box)
sonoko_hybrid.bonuses_and_penalties: Color-match bonus (+100 XP) when played card color matches the cell color. Hand limit is 12 cards (bust warning). Lives counter (3 hearts), combo multiplier (x2, x3, x5), score, timer, and active 'SONOKO!' call button when holding 1 card.

classic_sudoku.features: Difficulty selector (Easy, Medium, Hard), Number pad (1-9), Pencil/Notes toggle, Erase tool, Hint button, Mistakes counter (max 3), Timer, Pause modal.

classic_uno.features: Opponent hand card backs with remaining count, Turn indicator badge, Direction arrow indicator, Discard & Draw piles, Color-picker modal for Wild cards, 'UNO!' button with penalty draw check.

daily_challenge.description: Seeded daily Sonoko puzzle with fixed layout
daily_challenge.features: Daily streak tracker, global daily leaderboard submission with custom player name.

visual_enhancers.card_hand: Overlapping fanned layout with Framer Motion hover lift (-translate-y-4), active glow, and tap selection state
visual_enhancers.grid_animations: Particle burst / scale pulse when cell is solved; shake animation on invalid placement
visual_enhancers.confetti: Canvas-confetti or framer-motion celebratory particle burst on game win
visual_enhancers.toasts: Sonner toasts for achievements, combos, and Sonoko call notices

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (buttons, cards, cell inputs, mode tabs, input fields) MUST include data-testid

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a unified, ultra-polished React casual game application for 'Sonoko' owned by Treesh Games.
Persist user profile, level, XP, achievements, trophy cabinet, high scores, and stats in localStorage.
Ensure Sonoko hybrid mode combines 6x6 Sudoku rules with Uno matching mechanics and card hand management.
Ensure responsive layout works seamlessly on mobile devices (thumb-friendly bottom hand, vertical stack) and desktop devices (split view HUD).
Add audio toggle and sound effects (using Web Audio API synthetic tones or sound triggers) for card play, invalid move, win, and Sonoko calls.
Use Sonner for toasts (`import { toast } from 'sonner'`) to display achievements unlocked, combo streaks, and draw penalties.
Ensure all interactive buttons, grid cells, card items, and tabs include clear data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Do not build generic centered flat white templates. Use deep obsidian slate with vibrant neon UNO colors, glassmorphism backdrop blurs, crisp 1px borders, and tactile shadows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.font_genres: Use Barlow Condensed or Outfit for headings, JetBrains Mono for numbers, Inter for body text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_check: Ensure text visibility meets APCA standards. Set explicit hover colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never set transition: all globally. Set explicit transitions like transition-transform duration-200.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_compliance: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid in kebab-case.
